messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] eu-west-1 inference queue latency spike. Autoscaler attempted scale but failed to provision GPUs for 3 consecutive cycles. queue_length=245, 95p latency=6.2s. Paging on-call.

pagerduty: Paging @Sam (on-call) — priority: P1 — incident id INF-4231.

Sam (on-call): ack. I'm on it. Starting console check.

Maria (eng-infra): I'm seeing high preemption rates on the node group (spot interruptions). Autoscaler tried to replace 10 nodes, cloud API returned quota errors for a subset of SKUs.

Lee (sre): confirmed — cloud provider returned ENOQUOTA for a handful of A100 variants. Preemptions + quota = autoscaler thrash.

Sam (on-call): ETA 10m to triage. Can we fail traffic to eu-central while we stabilize? Jordan, can routing be toggled?

Jordan (prod): yes, we have regional-fallback flag. I can flip to route non-SLA customers to eu-central. For SLAs we keep eu-west but with degraded perf. Want me to start?

Sam (on-call): Do it. Prioritize quick mitigation, minimize 503s. Mark actions in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INF-4231

Jordan (prod): flipping flag now: `POST /api/v1/flags/regional-fallback {"eu-west": "fallback-eu-central"}` -> response 200. Routing change initiated. :signal_strength:

ops-bot: routing update applied. 40% of non-SLA traffic is now being routed to eu-central.

Maria (eng-infra): I'm raising the autoscaler min nodes to avoid thrash: `kubectl patch hpa inference-autoscaler -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":6}}'` — applying.

Lee (sre): also temporarily pinning to on-demand instances for replacement to avoid spot churn: updating node pool config (cloud UI).

Sam (on-call): monitoring queues… queue_length dropping: 245 -> 110 -> 30 in last 8m. 95p latency down to 2.1s. Good progress.

Nina (support): flagging known customer-impact: several heavy-batch customers in EU reported timeouts and elevated latency. I have opened support ticket SUP-992 for the top 3 accounts and informed account teams.

Jordan (prod): running a quick canary to ensure model semantics unaffected with routing change. No errors in canary traffic.

Maria (eng-infra): cloud quotas are the root cause. I'm opening a quota increase request (CRQ-1187) and also requesting temporary soft-reservation for 4 GPUs in eu-west.

Ezra (platform): documenting mitigation: 1) routing fallback applied, 2) minReplicas bumped, 3) node pool pinned to on-demand, 4) quota request submitted. Next steps: reserve capacity and fix autoscaler behavior on quota failures.

Sam (on-call): Are there any 5xx or customer-visible failures left?

Nina (support): we saw ~120 5xx errors during peak window (10:12–10:20 UTC). Most from batch endpoints timed out. I've notified 3 customers proactively.

Jordan (prod): rolling back routing for SLA customers only (keeping fallback for non-SLA). Done.

Sam (on-call): moving to incident state: mitigated. Not resolved until root cause fixed + postmortem scheduled.

incident-bot: Incident INF-4231 status changed: MITIGATED -> NOTES: routing fallback + autoscaler adjustments.

Lee (sre): quick triage notes: autoscaler does not mark quota responses as terminal; it keeps retrying and creates churn. Need to add detection for quota/ENOSPC and backoff.

Maria (eng-infra): action item: add quota error classification to autoscaler (INF-4240), owner: Maria, due: 2026-03-28.

Ezra (platform): action item: request dedicated reservation for eu-west GPUs (INF-4241), owner: Ezra, due: 2026-04-04.

Jordan (prod): action item: improve routing fallback heuristics so we can do faster non-SLA failovers without touching SLA flows, owner: Jordan, due: 2026-03-25.

Nina (support): action item: post-incident customer summary and outreach, owner: Nina, due: 2026-03-22. Ticket SUP-992 linked.

Sam (on-call): scheduling postmortem — propose Tues 2026-03-23 16:00 UTC. Please confirm availability. Agenda: timeline, root cause, short-term mitigations, long-term remediation, follow-up owners.

Maria (eng-infra): I can make it.

Lee (sre): available.

Jordan (prod): available.

Ezra (platform): available.

Nina (support): available.

Sam (on-call): scheduling meeting in calendar + creating postmortem doc: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INF-4231-draft. Meeting invite sent.

incident-bot: Postmortem draft created by Sam. Link added to incident log.

Lee (sre): immediate follow-up: add a short-term guard in autoscaler to treat quota errors as backoff (hotfix). I'll open PR today and request urgent review (PR: github.com/redwood/inference/pull/5189).

Maria (eng-infra): I'll coordinate with cloud team on quota escalation and try to secure a soft reservation for next 72h.

Jordan (prod): we should add a runbook step for manual region fallback and an ops page for how to flip the flag safely. I'll add to docs (docs/internal/regional-fallback.md).

Sam (on-call): good. After the postmortem, we need an owner to track progress on these action items in the infra epic. I nominate Maria as infra lead to track INF-4240/INF-4241. Maria?

Maria (eng-infra): accepted. I'll own the infra epic and update status weekly.

Nina (support): I'll prepare the customer post-incident email template and coordinate with account teams — will ping when ready.

Sam (on-call): closing incident channel for active mitigation. We'll reconvene in postmortem. Thanks everyone for fast responses. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident INF-4231 closed (mitigated) by Sam. Action items: INF-4240 (Maria), INF-4241 (Ezra), INF-4242 (Jordan), SUP-992 (Nina).

Jordan (prod): quick note — cost impact: routing extra 40% to eu-central increased cross-region egress for a period. Finance FYI, I'll add a short note to the incident doc.

Sam (on-call): added. Last check: queue stable at 12, p95 latency 1.4s. Marking last_message_ts 1782103720.

incident-bot: Incident summary saved to incident log.

Sam (on-call): follow-ups tracked in infra epic INF-4240. We'll check progress in next weekly infra sync. Thanks all.
